research_question: At two preidentified Seq5 disappearance frames, does any spatial memory tile in the actual native six-map bank have a conditional effect on raw localization or the visible SAM2 output?
scope: Post-hoc fixed-bank mechanism diagnostic only. It cannot establish a deployable selector, full-video efficacy, or a cohort effect.

model.dtype: native project inference dtype; deterministic two-thread replay

targets.selection_reason: Preidentified native prolonged-loss frames; exploratory and outcome-informed, not an evaluation sample.
targets.ground_truth_use: Used only for post-hoc score calculation; never used by SAM2 or to choose an intervention.

intervention.reuse: Existing modeling.within_frame_token_utility.WithinFrameTokenRead and its original-coordinate sparse gather path.
intervention.source_frames: At each target, enumerate every actual native intermediate spatial-memory source between the conditioning prompt and latest map; exclude both protected endpoints.
intervention.groups: Sixteen disjoint 16x16 tiles on each 64x64 source grid; remove one tile from one source only, jointly across all four memory-attention layers.
intervention.arms: One exact native/no-op replay plus all 16 single-tile removals for every eligible source frame.
fixed: native chronological frame schedule and memory writes through the later target (frame 184); the diagnostic stops propagation there because later frames cannot affect these fixed target-time banks
dense current-frame queries and original spatial/temporal coordinates
all other source frames, conditioning/latest maps and pointer tokens
intervention.writeback: Forbidden; every counterfactual reads a cloned captured native target state.

measurements: post-presence visible mask Dice, IoU, Boundary F, foreground area and output hash
pre-presence raw decoder mask Dice, IoU, Boundary F, foreground area and output hash
actual per-layer source IDs, token counts, kept-index hashes, pointer preservation and native-bank fingerprints

interpretation.tile_utility: Native Dice minus Dice after removing a tile; positive means this removal hurts that target conditional on the remaining bank. Negative means removal helps.
limitations: Tiles are 256-token groups, not individual vectors or semantic labels.
Removal changes attention normalization and all effects are conditional on the rest of the bank.
Choosing the best tile after seeing GT is an oracle description, not an inference-time rule.
Only two selected targets from one sequence are measured; no statistical or generalization claim is permitted.
interpretation.continuation: Do not implement a SAM2 modification or launch a cohort run from these outcomes alone. Any new selector must be frozen using inference-available inputs and independently validated on untouched videos.

integrity_requirements: Native/no-op outputs and object scores match the saved full-video native reference exactly at both targets.
All eligible source frames are enumerated in native order; no source substitution is allowed.
Each intervention removes exactly 256 spatial keys from exactly one source in each of four layers.

Pointers, all captured input tensors, the cloned target-time native memory-bank prefix, and the SAM2 parameter digest remain unchanged. Later growth of the live bank during chronological propagation is expected.
Two fresh-process executions produce identical intervention records and masks.
All artifacts, source hashes, commands and receipts are written to the mounted Google Drive output directory.
